what: XGP pilot round 3 (final design, validation only); pre-registered before any run
disclosure: The round-3 design was informed by the Step 9A test-set analysis (posture-class drift: without fine-tuning, older adults' LCI fell more in standing at 70%, sitting at 90% and lying at 50%; the accuracy gap widens at 90%). All round-3 tuning and selection use HARTH inner-validation windows of folds 0 and 1 and their older-like copies only; HAR70+ and the folds' test subjects are never loaded.
selection_rule_phase1: Phase 1, per scenario and level: B_set = the highest mean F1 on that window set among the scenario's baselines (no_finetune: l1, snip, l1_recon; finetune: l1, l1_kd, snip_kd, l1_kdaug at both r). Eligible configuration: mean F1_normal >= B_normal - 1 pt and mean F1_older_like >= B_older_like - 1 pt. Selected = the eligible configuration with the highest mean FA-LCI_val (mean over folds 0, 1 and seeds of each run's min(LCI_normal, LCI_older_like)); ties within 0.005 -> smaller beta, then smaller r. None eligible -> no configuration at that level (flagged, no fallback), and phase 2 skips it.
final_rule_phase2: Phase 2, per scenario: candidates = the full XGP and its single-component ablations, each at the selected per-level configuration; eligible = eligible (same F1 rule) at every level; final = the eligible candidate with the highest FA-LCI_val averaged over levels; ties within 0.005 -> fewer components, then the higher FA-LCI. No candidate eligible -> XGP not frozen for that scenario: report and stop. Components: no_finetune full = 4 (score, group, iter, recon), finetune full = 6 (+ aug, + dro); no_aug removes aug and dro.
amended: 2026-11-22, before any round-3 run: the older-like transform gains a per-sensor random 3D rotation (back and thigh triplets independently, axis uniform on the sphere, angle ~ U(-15, 15) deg; Um et al. 2017), applied after the time-stretch and amplitude steps, so that static postures change too. The first pre-registration (same day, no run used it) was replaced. Phase 1 runs with --curve-seeds 0; the full budget curve goes to 9B.
